user.title: Connect to Ferroli Home
user.description: Sign in with the same email address and password you use for the Ferroli Home / Four Solid mobile app. The integration will retrieve the devices registered to your account. If more than one is found, you can choose which to monitor. This unofficial integration is read-only and does not change your system's settings or schedules.

device.title: Select your device
device.description: Select the device to monitor in Home Assistant. Its existing name from Ferroli Home will be retained.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Ferroli Home
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again to resume monitoring.

error.cannot_connect: Could not contact the Ferroli cloud service.
error.rate_limited: The service is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.no_devices: No devices were found on this account. Check that your system is registered in the Ferroli Home / Four Solid app.

init.title: Update interval
init.description: Choose how often to retrieve the complete set of readings from the Ferroli cloud. The default is every 30 minutes.
